info.name: Guardhouse Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Guardhouse Backend.

**Setup:**
1. Set `baseUrl` (default: http://localhost:8080)
2. Call **Auth > Login** and copy the `token` from response
3. Set collection variable `token` (or use Tests tab to auto-save)

**Auth:** Use header `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` for protected routes.

item.name: Auth
item.description: User authentication: signup, login, forget/reset password, logout, get users.

request.description:
**Request:** name, email, password, role, phone (required). Optional: companyId, createdBy. Role must be: SUPER_ADMIN | ADMIN | MANAGER | STAFF.

**Response 201:** `{ message, user: { id, name, email, role, phone, companyId, createdBy } }`

**Request:** email, password.

**Response 200:** `{ message, token, id, email, name }` — Save `token` in collection variable for other requests.
